comparison_policy: All candidate transforms scored on the SAME two retained prior camera samples, each compared to a different position in the original NEXT full public 7x7 uint8 view; never reward extra/missing pixels.
training_objective: Pre-action softmax over 3 geometric hypotheses from 7 action-only fixed features; after source original env.step, optimize expected exact public triple agreement with policy-gradient of expected agreement. No world labels or hidden pose.
trainable_slots: Use original 3x7=21 shared coefficients and leave original 8x3=24 local coefficients unchanged; <=45 original native coefficients total, no additions.
reported_controls: both fixed source-action camera mappings (not privileged grid)
additional_transient_observation: original public 7x7x3 uint8 147 bytes is current input, NOT persistent memory; account for Python/source copies and allocations in future full resource qualification
frozen_acceptance: same-weight native source prior+post custody; Windows and Linux exact values; on prospective DEV camera turns candidate must exceed BOTH fixed source-action mapping controls to justify further architectural training investigation. A positive camera match does not demonstrate physical object identity or independent scientific transfer.
